topic: misbehavior-triggered cutoff policy for AI/ML workloads on PCI devices (ADR-033): policy design, ideation and decision record, trigger tiers, governance

subtopics.scope: The vfio-user / IOMMU-gated PCI passthrough mediation boundary the policy sits on, and why a host-side device server is the cutoff point.

vfio-user server DMA mediation device isolation hypervisor

subtopics.scope: The IOMMU/DMA threat model for GPU passthrough: why DMA from a device can read host memory and exfiltrate secrets without touching the network.

Thunderbolt DMA attack external DMA protection IOMMU

subtopics.scope: Severity-ladder escalation policy design: INFO/WARN/THROTTLE/SEVER tiers, monotonicity, and mapping trigger signal to tier to action.

adaptive security response graduated enforcement escalation model

subtopics.scope: Detecting AI/ML workload misbehavior from a host-side device observer without seeing model internals: DMA-window anomaly signals and false-positive risk.

virtual machine malicious workload detection false positives behavioral monitoring

subtopics.scope: Snapshot-and-sever at SEVER: VM state capture (qcow2 snapshots), vfio-user socket revocation, freezing rather than killing the VM, and forensic recovery.

libvirt snapshot memory state forensic analysis virtualization
